checks.name: 48_samples_to_odd_columns
checks.detail: 48 tubes -> 48 wells, odd columns only: True

checks.name: step_order
checks.detail: expected per well: beads > isopropanol > sample > remove > ethanol > remove > ethanol > remove > elution > recover

checks.name: fresh_tip_per_sample_no_cross_contact
checks.detail: 48 distinct tips for 48 sample transfers; violations: []

items.evidence: apiLevel 2.9; every volume (40 to 400 uL on the p1000/p300 ranges, 15 uL air gaps, 185 uL aspirations) is within pipette limits; reservoir columns stay under 15 mL (check passed); the simulator completed without error.

The p1000 uses a fresh tip per sample (check: 48 distinct tips, no violations). The multichannel uses a new tip per column for removal and elution. Shared tips for reagent additions dispense at top(-15) without touching wells. Every tip is dropped.

The order and values match the paper: 40 uL beads, 250 uL isopropanol, 250 uL sample, mix 5x, 5 min, magnet 4 min, two 500 uL ethanol washes, 4 min dry, 100 uL elution, 30 s, 90 s, and an elution plate at 4 C. All 17 measured checks pass. The 90 uL recovery is a reasonable choice, since the paper does not state a volume.
Check 48_samples_to_odd_columns passed. The code builds sample_wells from odd columns A1..H11 and pairs each sample with its own well and its own elution well.

Checks binding_volumes_40_250_250, mix_5x_after_sample, incubation_5min_before_magnet, magnet_4min_before_first_removal and magnet_engaged_for_all_removals all passed. The code adds beads, then isopropanol, then sample, with p1000.mix(5,...), a 5 min delay, engage, a 4 min delay and removal to waste.
Checks two_500ul_ethanol_washes and air_dry_4min passed. Each wash is added and then removed to waste with the magnet engaged. A 4 min delay follows, and mag_mod.disengage() comes before elution.

Checks elution_100ul, elution_off_magnet_then_90s_on, recover_70_100ul_one_well_each, distinct_elution_wells and elution_plate_4C_before_recovery passed. Recovery is 90 uL, slightly above the roughly 80 uL target but inside the measured 70-100 uL window.

judge.summary: The protocol passed all 17 measured run-log checks, which cover volumes, order, timing, magnet use, per-sample tips and distinct elution wells. The only notable deviation is recovering 90 uL instead of about 80 uL of eluate, which the checks accept, so I scored every item 1.
